_meta.name: October 2024 Storm
_meta.notes: G4 storm (Kp 8 peak). X9.0 flare from AR3848. Fast CME arrival (~34 hours). Demonstrated improved forecasting lead time vs. historical events.
_meta.impact: Strongest Dst since 2003, aurora to mid-latitudes, HF radio blackout on sunlit side, GIC monitoring activated in NA/EU grids
